# Every African Company that was Present at Moonshot 2026 and the Problems They're Solving
## Payments and Cross-Border Money Companies at Moonshot 2026
### 13. Bluebulb (Nigeria / UK)
![Bluebulb product screenshot](https://assets.liners.com/storage/v1/object/public/media/tools/bluebulb/screenshot.webp)

[Bluebulb](https://liners.com/bluebulb) handles cross-border payments, FX and treasury for African corporates.

**The solution:** Pay-ins, payouts, FX and collections to the UK, US, EU and China, plus Orbita, a self-service treasury dashboard. Its clients include Oando and Nigerian Breweries.

## Crypto and Digital Asset Companies at Moonshot 2026
### 43. Bitoshi Africa, Doux Finance and MyPadi AI (Nigeria)
![Doux Finance product screenshot](https://assets.liners.com/storage/v1/object/public/media/tools/doux/screenshot.webp)

![Bitoshi Africa product screenshot](https://assets.liners.com/storage/v1/object/public/media/content/inline/4e3b58c5-e165-41c5-b723-094f66cbe83b.webp?v=1793547784397)

![MyPadi AI product screenshot](https://assets.liners.com/storage/v1/object/public/media/content/inline/68221acc-7520-433c-9af3-ed7f055bc878.webp?v=1793547821927)

- **[Bitoshi Africa](https://liners.com/bitoshi):** Founded in 2020, Bitoshi lets everyday users buy, sell and spend Bitcoin and USDT, with Naira wallets, bill payments and a dollar card.
- **[Doux Finance](https://liners.com/doux):** A neobank for Africans paid by foreign employers, with cards that spend from USDT and USDC balances.
- **[MyPadi AI](https://mypadi.ai/?utm_source=liners.com):** A WhatsApp assistant that converts BTC, ETH or USDT to Naira or rand by chat, settling straight to a bank account.

## Commerce, Logistics, Mobility and Travel Companies at Moonshot 2026
### 53. HomeFairyTech (Nigeria)
![HomeFairyTech product screenshot](https://assets.liners.com/storage/v1/object/public/media/content/inline/7f7c6598-9206-42dc-85d0-e766ae3370ea.webp?v=1793547850823)

[HomeFairyTech](https://homefairytech.com/?utm_source=liners.com) is a shortlet marketplace that verifies agents and property owners.

**The problem:** Shortlet guests in Nigeria regularly pay fake agents for apartments that don't exist.

**The solution:** ID and face checks for agents and owners, escrow payments and deal rooms, live in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt.

## Health, Legal, Education and Climate Companies at Moonshot 2026
### 71. Earthbond (Nigeria)
Nigerians spend over $22 billion a year on generator fuel.

Earthbond raised pre-seed funding from Madica.
